name: Saruman
subtitle: Master of Foul Folk
game_text:
Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish.
Each time the fellowship moves, you may heal each <culture>Isengard</culture> Orc twice.
<phase>Shadow</phase>: Exert Saruman to play an <culture>Isengard</culture> possession from your discard pile.
